name: Water Monkey Camp
description_short: Overnight watersports camp on Merrymeeting Lake in New Durham, NH, focused on wakeboarding, waterskiing, wakesurfing and wake skating. Weekly sessions take a maximum of 9 campers ages 9-17, who stay in lakeside cabins with counselors.
refund_policy_summary: The $1,750-per-week tuition deposit is fully refundable until April 1. After that date, no refunds are given for any reason.
special_needs_notes: Food allergies and dietary needs can be fully accommodated if the camp is told in advance. The chef cooks all meals from scratch.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on the shore of Merrymeeting Lake and has a sandy beach. All staff must be certified lifeguards. There is at least 1 counselor for every 3 campers, and no more than 9 campers per week. Boat lessons continue in rain unless there is thunder or lightning. The camp provides all watersports and safety equipment and uses a Supra SV450 boat in 2027.
